CustomField.description: Base URL DocuSign returns the signer to after signing, without a trailing slash. Set explicitly rather than inferred from Site.getBaseUrl() so sandbox and production cannot silently diverge. Must be this site: the return page has to be same origin for the journey to detect completion through the iframe. Carries no session token. Must also be added to the SELECT in ADHA_JourneyController.settings() or it reads as null.
CustomField.label: Signing Return Base Url
